gcash_gsave.note: Official CIMB advisory: 2.30% base from 2026-06-01 (was 2.60%). GCash help centre says interest credited monthly on average daily balance. Earn More promo up to ~4.15% ignored.

maya_savings.note: Maya's own page: 3% p.a. base from 2026-05-01 (was 3.5%). Credited daily per Maya pages quoted in search. Up to 15% boost/promo ignored. One Radar report said an April cut was shelved, but Maya's May 1 page states 3%.

maya_personal.note: Base 4% p.a. per goal, interest computed daily, credited on 1st of next month. Current Oct-Dec 2026 promo tiers: 4% to 20k, 4.5% to 40k, 5% to 60k, 6.5% to 80k, 8% to 100k, nothing above 100k; 4% is the lowest tier.

bpi.note: Official BPI page: 0.0625% p.a., only when daily balance is at least PHP 5,000. BPI rate sheet says savings interest is generally credited QUARTERLY (Maxi-Saver monthly); nearest supported = MONTHLY.

bdo.note: Fallback only: comparison sites (pesohub checked 2026-09-28, finmerkado) list BDO Passbook/Prime/Kabayan savings at 0.0625%, interest needs PHP 10,000 balance. No BDO Unibank official page could be read (bdo.com.ph timed out; the bdonetworkbank page is a different bank). Crediting frequency not confirmed, assumed quarterly -> MONTHLY.

unionbank.note: Unverified: third-party blogs say UnionBank Personal Savings 0.10% p.a. with PHP 10,000 balance to earn interest; unionbankph.com returned 403. Crediting frequency unknown, assumed MONTHLY.

gotyme.note: Official GoTyme page: GoalSave 3.0% p.a. flat (cut from 3.5% on 2026-01-01). Official page does not state crediting; phbanks.com (checked 2026-10-21) says daily.

maribank.note: Official: 3.25% p.a. on balance up to PHP 1M, 3.75% above PHP 1M, credited nightly at midnight, 20% tax withheld. No maintaining balance.

metrobank.note: Official Metrobank regular savings page: 0.0625%, PHP 10,000 to earn interest (page does not say 'p.a.'; pesohub 2026-09-28 lists the passbook at 0.0625% too; an older 0.25% figure appears on one comparison site). Metrobank article: interest computed annually and credited QUARTERLY; nearest = MONTHLY.

securitybank.note: Unverified guess: securitybank.com pages returned 403 and no search gave a current eSecure/regular savings base rate (stale third-party range 0.50-1.2% from 2021 for eSecure; help centre only shows a 0.10% penalty rate when withdrawal limit is exceeded). 0.0625 is the common big-bank peso base. Crediting unknown.

cimb.note: Official CIMB advisory: UpSave, GSave, DragonFi Save and Grow base 2.30% from 2026-06-01. Crediting taken from GCash help (monthly on average daily balance), not from the advisory itself. Earn More promo up to ~4.15% ignored.

landbank.note: Landbank interest-rates page (seen in search results, undated) and a comparison site list regular passbook savings at 0.05% with PHP 10,000 to earn interest; my direct fetch of the site failed (404), so not confirmed current. Crediting unknown.

rcbc.note: Official RCBC page: iSave (the no-maintaining-balance account that opens in minutes) 0.15% to 0.20%, tiered; 0.150% is the lowest tier (PHP 5,000 to under 100,000 per RCBC iSave page). RCBC Regular Savings ATM/passbook rate is not published ('a small interest rate'). Crediting not stated; assumed MONTHLY. Pulz-specific rate not published.

pnb.note: Official PNB passbook page (via search result, undated): 0.100% p.a., PHP 10,000 minimum ADB to earn interest. My fetch of the page returned only headings, so not confirmed current. Crediting unknown.

chinabank.note: Unverified: moneymax lists Easi-Save Basic at 0.125% p.a. (PHP 1,000 to earn interest); an undated uploaded rate sheet also shows 0.125%. No chinabank.ph page could be found. Crediting unknown.

eastwest.note: Official EastWest rates page: Regular Savings 0.100% p.a., needs PHP 10,000 to earn interest (cut from 0.125% effective 2025-11-15 per EastWest advisory). Crediting frequency not stated; assumed MONTHLY.

psbank.note: Rate NOT found: PSBank's official passbook page only says 'see prevailing rates'. It confirms interest is credited MONTHLY and starts at PHP 10,000 balance. 0.10% is a placeholder guess in line with peers (unrelated third-party snippet said 0.50% for an OFW account).

aub.note: Unverified: finmerkado lists AUB Starter Savings (PHP 1,000) and Preferred Peso Savings at 0.100% p.a.; aub.com.ph showed no rates. Crediting unknown.

maybank.note: Unverified: a Maybank PH rate sheet seen in search results lists Classic Savings 0.125% (as of Feb 2025 per the result); official page timed out. MP1 savings is tiered by balance and withdrawals, tiers not retrieved. Crediting unknown.

hsbcph.note: Official HSBC PH page: Peso Savings 0.005% p.a., no tiers, no minimum, but requires HSBC Premier/Advance eligibility. Interest calculated daily; page text says 'credited monthly quarterly' (contradictory), so MONTHLY chosen.

tonik.note: Official Tonik page: Solo Stash 3.25% p.a. on end-of-day balance (plain Tonik Account only 0.1%; Group Stash 3.75% with 2+ savers ignored). Official page does not say when credited; phbanks.com (checked 2026-10-21) says daily.

uno.note: Unverified, sources conflict (uno.bank returned 403). 2026 comparison sites (pesohub, phbanks): 3.00% under PHP 5,000, 3.50% from PHP 5,000, 1.00% from PHP 5M, whole balance, credited daily. Older UNO page snippets showed 3.50% / 4.25% instead. 3.00% is the lowest tier; 3.50% is likely what a normal saver sees.

uniondigital.note: Unverified: UD Save 3.00% p.a. (3.25% from PHP 5M), dated 2026-02-25 on phbanks.com. No official UnionDigital page found; crediting not stated, DAILY assumed as for other PH digital banks.

ownbank.note: Official OwnBank help-centre notice: Own It 3.8% p.a. effective 2025-08-27; pesohub (checked 2026-09-24) still lists 3.80% credited daily. Official notice does not state crediting itself; basic accounts capped at PHP 50,000.

komo.note: Unverified: App Store listing says 'up to 2.5% per annum, no minimum deposit or maintaining balance' (undated); no official Komo rate page found and crediting frequency unknown. 'Up to' may be a tier max.
